title: Moraine Lake & Lake Louise Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
* Guaranteed access to Moraine Lake – Avoid the parking restrictions and travel with a licensed commercial shuttle.

* Visit Two Iconic Lakes – Enjoy plenty of free time at both Lake Louise and Moraine Lake for sightseeing and photography.

* Convenient Pickup – Easy pickup from selected locations in Banff and Canmore.

* Comfortable Shared Shuttle – Travel in a clean, comfortable vehicle with a professional local driver.

* Stress-Free Experience – No need to worry about parking, driving, or shuttle reservations. Just relax and enjoy your day.
